text:
sasha: Hey team — my PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/12987) is blocked by a flaky CI failure. tests/integration/kv_store_test on shard-2 times out waiting for snapshot in ~1/10 runs. Not sure if this needs a snapshot update or just a retry. Can someone rerun or bump priority?

tonny: can you paste the failing log snippet? and is this happening on the integration pipeline or e2e?

sasha: integration pipeline. here is the last failing line from the job log: `ERROR: timeout while waiting for snapshot: last_seq=4521, waited=30s`. Rest of tests pass locally.

ci-bot: buildkite: #12987 (integration) — failed on shard-2 — link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5167 — exit code 1.

liam: if it's non-deterministic and not a regression, we usually just rerun once or twice. do you know if this will block any release windows?

sasha: no release risk, it's a small doc + test fix. just need green to merge and then meredith can approve.

meredith: i can approve once CI is green. can someone kick a rerun? busy this morning but will check back. :raised_hands:

engine-oncall: you can bump the job priority with the retry CLI or via the pipeline UI. quick snippet:```
/ci retry --build 5167 --pipeline integration --priority high
```
or visit the build link and click "retry" then pick "high priority". tag me if it needs manual intervention.

jamal: i can kick the retry now, will do one high-priority rerun and watch.

ci-bot: buildkite: #12987 (integration) — retry started by jamal — queue position: 1 — priority: high.

ci-bot: buildkite: #12987 (integration) — shard-2 rerun started.

ci-bot: buildkite: #12987 (integration) — shard-2 rerun succeeded (all tests passed). total time 12m. :white_check_mark:

jamal: rerun done and green. meredith — feel free to approve when you get a sec. sasha — you should be unblocked to merge. :rocket:

meredith: approving now. nice catch, retry flow looks healthy.

sasha: thanks everyone! leaving a quick note in the PR about the transient snapshot timeout and that we retried once. will watch for recurrence. :thumbsup:
